findings.description: Critical: cycle_state.py compute_fingerprint() excludes only cycle-ledger.json and supervisor-record.json from _tree_listing(), causing writes under openspec/supervise/candidates/ or digest.json to mutate the fingerprint, break score caching, and prevent unchanged-tree early exits; wp-digest-module is currently denied access to cycle_state.py in work-packages.yaml.
findings.resolution: Update work-packages.yaml scope for wp-digest-module to allow editing cycle_state.py, and update _tree_listing() in cycle_state.py to exclude all of openspec/supervise/ or candidates/ and digest.json.

findings.description: Critical: digest.py rank and decide lack a CLI timestamp parameter (e.g. --now), preventing deterministic generated_at and decided_at timestamps required for byte-for-byte matching against digest-expected.json in Task 1.3 and satisfying the spec idempotency scenario.
findings.resolution: Specify an optional --now CLI flag on digest.py rank and decide to allow passing deterministic ISO timestamps during unit tests and fixture comparisons.

findings.description: Nit: rubric-score.schema.json sets minItems: 1 on scores array, which would reject an empty rubric score payload if an empty stub batch is validated.
findings.resolution: Change minItems from 1 to 0 in rubric-score.schema.json for scores array, or explicitly document that rubric sub-agent dispatch and scoring are skipped when fresh stubs count is zero.

findings.description: Nit: The contract documentation and schemas omit the explicit JSON schema definition for per-stub cached <stub_key>.rubric.json files.
findings.resolution: Document the JSON shape of per-stub <stub_key>.rubric.json files in contracts/README.md or add a definition in rubric-score.schema.json.

findings.description: Optional: templates/rubric-prompt.md relies on host-rendered {{batch}} slots containing provenance excerpts, which should be bounded to prevent excessive prompt lengths.
findings.resolution: Accept design D2 and task 2.2 prompt template structure.

findings.description: The architecture cleanly separates model scoring from deterministic ranking, uses refine-roadmap preview/apply for transaction safety, and prevents supervisor scripts from directly mutating roadmap.yaml.
findings.resolution: Accept Approach 1 design and refine-roadmap approval routing.

findings.description: Work packages and task breakdowns follow strict TDD ordering, clear file locks, and valid DAG dependencies across all 5 phases.
findings.resolution: Accept work-packages.yaml and tasks.md execution structure.
